expectedThingsPrinted: You are standing outside the office building.
The door is slightly ajar, revealing a dimly lit interior.
What do you want to do?
You decide it's better to be safe than sorry.
You turn around and head home.
The next day, you're sipping coffee on your porch, safe from any demon possession.
{"jLineColor":4,"text":"You chose to go home and survived!"}
